addon.name: Merge Playlist into one File
addon.summary: Combine all the tracks of a playlist into a single audio file.
addon.description:
Turns a playlist into one continuous audio file, which is far easier to copy onto a phone, a car stereo or an MP3 player than a folder full of separate tracks.
If your playlist trims tracks so they start or stop part-way through, those trims are kept.
To use it: open your playlist in VLC, then choose View, then Merge Playlist into one File. Check where the file will be saved, choose the sound quality and press Convert. It takes roughly one minute for every hour of audio, and VLC cannot play anything else while it works.
The result is saved as an .m4a file, which plays on phones, computers and most car stereos.
